title: gpbiometricspy: Python tools for Gazepoint biometric workflows
description: gpbiometricspy is the Python counterpart of gpbiometrics, with gpbiometrics 2.0.0 frozen as its initial semantic reference. It provides Gazepoint-native workflows for EDA/GSR/SCR, PPG/HRV, pupil, gaze, fixation, AOI, TTL/event alignment, multimodal quality control, analysis, plotting, reporting, simulation, reproducibility, and interoperability.
